lines.text: Sara drove to the Smokies for peak fall color and sat in traffic for two hours.
Every lot was full, and she had no parking tag.
Buy your parking tag before you arrive,
because any car parked longer than fifteen minutes needs one.
Hit the trailhead at sunrise on a weekday,
when the color is just as bright and the trail is quiet.
Sara's second trip was pure gold.
Save this before your Smokies trip.
